title: Bound by the largest part
statement: Let $r$ be a positive integer, let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $R$ be a finite set of vertices partitioned into $2r$ parts, each containing $k$ possible vertices. The size of $R$ is at most $2r$ times the number of its vertices in a part having the largest such count.
hypotheses_covered: R is a finite subset of the vertices in 2r parts, each with k possible vertices
